philippines.name: Barrio at Midnight
philippines.intro: A quiet barrio. Everyone is indoors. Garlic hangs from every door but one.

japan.name: Abandoned Mountain Shrine
japan.intro: Moss-covered steps. Paper talismans flutter on a rope. One of them is torn.

mexico.name: River Bank at Dusk
mexico.intro: A dry riverbed and a distant sound of weeping. The marigolds are wilting.

malaysia.name: Kampung After Rain
malaysia.intro: Wet leaves, stilted houses, frangipani. A baby is crying somewhere that has no babies.

ukraine.name: Reed River at Midsummer
ukraine.intro: Tall reeds, still water, and a song you almost recognize.

scotland.name: Orkney Shoreline
scotland.intro: Wind, kelp and black stone. Something huge breathes in the fog.

south_africa.name: Homestead at Night
south_africa.intro: A dry-grass homestead. The beds inside are all raised on bricks. You wonder why.

canada.name: Boreal Winter Forest
canada.intro: Snow, spruce, and silence. The tracks you are following are far too large.
